passages.text: Operations The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes included elsewhere in this Annual Report . Some of the information contained in the following discussion and analysis includes forward- looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Refer to the sections entitled “Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” and “Risk Factors” for a discussion of forward-looking statements and important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements contained in the following discussion and analysis. Overview We are a building solutions company focused on the North American market, offering customers a broad range of advanced building solutions from foundation to rooftop. We serve customers across the infrastructure, commercial, and residential construction markets, from new builds to repair and refurbishment (“R&R”). Our more than 19,000 employees operate across more than 1,000 sites and facilities in the United States, Canada, Colombia, Switzerland and Jamaica, providing customers with trusted brands and advanced building solutions for the full building lifecycle. Our trusted brands and advanced solutions, combined with our operational expertise, make us a trusted partner for customers, consisting of contractors, building owners, architects, engineers, public authorities and cities across the United States and Canada. We earn revenue from the sale of cement, aggregates, ready-mix concrete, asphalt, roofing systems and other building solutions. We operate in two reportable segments, offering a complete range of advanced solutions to support large-scale and complex construction projects from bridges to data centers in the areas of residential, commercial and infrastructure construction. Our services span new construction as well as R&R, with R&R accounting for 43% of overall revenues in the year ended December 31, 2025 . • Our Building Materials segment offers a range of branded solutions delivering high-quality products for a wide range of applications across North America. Key product offerings of this segment include cement and aggregates, as well as a variety of downstream products and solutions such as ready- mix concrete, asphalt and other construction materials. • Our Building Envelope segment offers advanced roofing and wall systems, including single-ply membranes, insulation, shingles, sheathing, waterproofing and protective coatings, along with adhesives, tapes and sealants that are critical to the application of roofing and wall systems. Our Building Envelope products are sold individually or in warrantied systems for new construction or R&R in commercial and residential projects. These products are sold either directly to contractors or through an authorized distributor or dealer network in North America. Seasonality Our Building Materials segment results for the first and fourth quarters are generally lower than those for the second and third quarters, which benefit from more favorable weather

credit_strengths.text: Amrize's operating margin sits below the Materials sector median, reflecting a building solutions mix weighted toward cement, aggregates and roofing rather than higher-margin specialties. Still, the absolute margin is solid for a capital-intensive producer, and repair and refurbishment work provides recurring demand that cushions new-build cyclicality.

Operating cash flow comfortably funds capital expenditure, leaving meaningful free cash flow. That internally generated liquidity supports the dividend and modest bolt-on acquisitions without incremental borrowing, a positive for a company that recently separated from its former parent and is establishing a standalone capital structure.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a large unsecured note stack with staggered maturities, including a current portion due within the next year and a sizeable bullet in the fifth year. Refinancing that ladder depends on continued market access, and the exchange offers that created much of the stack show the capital structure is still being reshaped.

The risk-factor passage flags forward-looking statements and contingencies including legal proceedings and regulatory compliance, while the business spans multiple jurisdictions and construction end-markets. Seasonality in Building Materials means first and fourth quarter results are generally weaker, so cash generation is uneven through the year.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is well below the sector median, indicating thinner headroom than Materials peers. The gap partly reflects the newly standalone capital structure and the debt raised around the spin-off, so coverage should be monitored as the business seasons and the note stack amortizes.

The current ratio is below the sector median, though current assets still exceed current liabilities. Liquidity is adequate but not generous, and the absence of a tagged debt balance means leverage and free-cash-flow-to-debt cannot be computed from the standard tags, a material gap for assessing the capital structure.

overall_credit_view.text: Amrize is a diversified North American building solutions issuer with solid absolute profitability and cash generation, but its indicative financial risk profile cannot be fully assessed because debt is not assembled from standard tags. Leverage and cash-flow coverage metrics are therefore unavailable, limiting comparative judgement against the sector.

Our forward view is that internally funded free cash flow and a staggered unsecured maturity profile should support debt service, provided construction demand holds and refinancing remains accessible. We would seek the debt note and lease detail to complete leverage and coverage analysis before finalizing any internal limit.

credit_strengths.text: Amrize 的營業利潤率低於 Materials 行業中位數，反映其建築解決方案組合偏重水泥、骨料與屋頂材料，而非利潤率較高的特種產品。儘管如此，對於資本密集型生產商而言，其絕對利潤率仍屬穩健，而維修與翻新工程提供經常性需求，可緩衝新建工程的週期性波動。
營運現金流足以輕鬆支應資本支出，並留下可觀的自由現金流。該內部產生的流動性可支持股息及小規模補強型收購，而無需新增借款，這對一家近期從前母公司分拆、正建立獨立資本結構的公司而言屬正面因素。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露了龐大的無抵押票據組合，到期日分散，包括未來一年內到期的一部分流動部分，以及第五年的一筆大額子彈式到期。為該到期階梯再融資取決於持續的市場准入，而創造該組合大部分的交換要約顯示資本結構仍在重塑之中。
風險因素章節標示了前瞻性陳述及或有事項，包括法律程序與監管合規，而業務橫跨多個司法管轄區及建築終端市場。Building Materials 的季節性意味著第一及第四季度業績通常較弱，因此全年現金產生並不平均。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率遠低於行業中位數，顯示緩衝空間較 Materials 同業為薄。該差距部分反映新獨立的資本結構及分拆前後籌集的債務，因此隨著業務經歷季節性變化及票據組合攤還，應密切監察覆蓋率。
流動比率低於行業中位數，儘管流動資產仍超過流動負債。流動性充足但並不寬裕，而缺乏標籤化的債務餘額意味著槓桿及自由現金流對債務比率無法從標準標籤計算，這對評估資本結構而言是重大缺口。

overall_credit_view.text: Amrize 是一家多元化的北美建築解決方案發行人，具備穩健的絕對盈利能力及現金產生能力，但由於債務並非從標準標籤彙編，其指示性財務風險狀況無法全面評估。因此，槓桿及現金流覆蓋指標無法取得，限制了與行業的比較判斷。
我們的前瞻觀點是，內部融資的自由現金流及分散的無抵押到期結構應可支持債務償付，前提是建築需求保持穩定且再融資仍可獲得。在最終確定任何內部限額之前，我們會索取債務票據及租賃明細，以完成槓桿及覆蓋分析。
